overall.verdict: A disciplined, coherent dark fintech UI whose green=vulnerable-free / violet=promise semantics and provable receipts genuinely differentiate it; Desk and Pay are close to shipping quality. It is held back by three repeated failures: credit/collateral widgets leaking into unrelated flows (Swap, Assets, Lend), clipped right-edge content on the two most data-dense screens, and internal jargon (lazy entity, lines out·in, depository may pull) presented without translation.
priority_fixes: Fix horizontal overflow on 15-sovereignty and 16-desk — the dispute path and live book are the product's proof-of-trust and price-discovery moments and both are cut off
Extract the 'Prepare to receive / Extend credit limit' widget into a single dedicated account-scoped surface and remove it from Swap, Assets and faucet flows
Run a terminology unification pass: one name each for reserve/promise/collateral/allowance across Home, Manage, Assets, Sovereignty
Make trust artifacts interactive everywhere: copyable proof hashes, clickable frame #719, downloadable/forwardable receipt in Activity detail
Soften jargon with plain-language glosses ('lazy entity', 'Depository may pull', 'LINES OUT·IN') or in-place tooltips
